title.name: Pulse
title.sub: Pulse learns how often each battery device reports and notices when one goes quiet. It only listens, never polls.

new.title: Reachable means fine
new.text: For Matter devices and cloud devices with a connectivity sensor, Pulse asks the integration. A rarely used lock or a rain gauge on a dry day is no longer unusually silent.

new.title: Restarts no longer fool Pulse
new.text: After a Home Assistant restart a silent device briefly looked alive again. The state rows HA rewrites on start no longer count as reports.

new.title: Battery forecast
new.text: From Home Assistant's long-term statistics Pulse estimates how long a battery will last, as a rough range. The battery card lists what is due in the next eight weeks.

new.title: Radio, but no values
new.text: With Zigbee2MQTT's health check Pulse notices devices that still talk to the network but no longer send readings. At most Check, never Failed.

new.title: Cloud outages stay calm
new.text: When several devices of one cloud integration go quiet together, that is the cloud, not the batteries. One message instead of an alarm per device.

new.title: Partner suggestions
new.text: Devices that were active together on several days, such as a lock and its door contact, show up in the device sheet. Accept them and Pulse cross-checks.

notify.title: Levels
notify.text: Failed, Check and Battery each go right away, in the daily summary, or not at all. Important devices send Check right away.

notify.title: Quiet hours and at home
notify.text: Notifications wait for quiet hours and for someone to come home. Only the latest message per device is kept; a device that failed and recovered at night sends nothing.

notify.title: Critical alerts
notify.text: Break through Do Not Disturb when an important device fails. iOS needs permission for critical alerts, Android uses the alarm channel.

notify.title: Buttons that work
notify.text: Battery replaced records a replacement, Remind tomorrow stays quiet for 24 hours. Right in the notification, for everyone.

notify.title: One message for an outage
notify.text: Three or more devices silent in the same minute is a hub or bridge, not the batteries: one calm message naming them. The same for a cloud outage.

notify.title: Batteries to buy
notify.text: The daily summary mentions batteries forecast to run out in the next eight weeks. It only goes out because of a battery when one is due now.
